title: THEMol/GFN2-xTB registry-wide orbital expansion: 166 -> 5,117 molecules, with the cross-level calibration re-fit on thousands of pairs instead of 74 anchors
question: W17-14 could only compare GFN2-xTB against the wB97X-V/def2-TZVPPD/SMD(18.5) reference on 74 paired anchors, which is why its three channels stayed `reference_only`. THEMol covers 5,117 of the repository's 31,949 key-registry molecules. Does running the whole covered set (a) give reference-only HOMO/LUMO to 421 molecules that have none, and (b) change the cross-level verdict once the calibration pair count grows by ~60x?
why_now: The author asked for the HOMO/LUMO channel to be collected for real, pointed at THEMol, and asked for the THEMol work to be parallelised across several agents. W17-14 answered 'THEMol is a geometry source, not an orbital source' on 74 anchors; that answer is only as strong as its sample.

themol_index.note: rows are exactly the registry keys present in the THEMol Hessian pool

prior_arm.note: W17-14: 166 molecules harvested (142 eps + 72 anchors, overlapping), verdict reference_only on all three channels, gates MAE <= 0.35 eV and r >= 0.80

source.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (data) / Apache-2.0 (code); derived values are non-commercial
source.what_themol_stores: atomic_numbers, coords, hessian only - no eigenvalue, no gap, no IP/EA; the orbital numbers in this arm are computed here, not read from the dataset

engine.job: --sp (single point on the THEMol DFT geometry, gas phase)
engine.runner: electrolyte_ml.xtb_runner (OMP_NUM_THREADS pinned to 1, private scratch directory per molecule)
engine.geometry_provenance: per-row geometry_sha256 of the exact XYZ handed to xTB

run_plan.sharding_rule: whole hessian_N.h5 containers dealt round-robin, so no two shards ever open the same HDF5 file
run_plan.network_model: ~175 KB/s per HTTP range stream measured on hf-mirror; ~0.86 MB of geometry per molecule; aggregate scales with stream count

judgements.A_harvest_integrity: every delivered row has a non-empty geometry_sha256, returncode 0, finite homo_eV/lumo_eV and gap == lumo - homo to 1e-9; otherwise the row is reported as failed, never silently dropped
judgements.B_structure: per-row InChIKey recomputed from the row's own SMILES must equal the roster InChIKey (same rule as W17-14)
judgements.C_unit: the eV column of the '# Occupation Energy/Eh Energy/eV' table is the source; an independent re-parse of the stored xTB output must reproduce every delivered number
judgements.D_cross_level_gate: inherited verbatim from probes/orbital_second_source_prereg.json: a channel is `calibrated` only if out-of-sample MAE <= 0.35 eV AND r >= 0.80; otherwise it is `reference_only`
judgements.E_calibration_protocol: same 2-fold out-of-sample protocol as W17-14 (split by canonical SMILES hash, fixed seed), now applied to every pair that has both a GFN2 number and a Batt wB97X-V number
judgements.F_no_regression_of_prior_arms: data/processed/themol_orbital_layer.csv and four_core_key_registry.csv bytes must not change; the expanded layer is a new additive file

compliance.raw_layer_gitignored: data/raw/** is ignored; the CC BY-NC geometry derivative never enters a tracked path
compliance.tracked_values: only the delivery layer and its summaries, each row carrying source_dataset / source_level / source_license
